full_judgment: 2. The opposite party as plaintiff filed Title Suit No.203 of 1987 in the court of the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Jhalakati, for declaration of title and for further declaration that the decree passed in Title Suit No. 329 of 1957 of the First Court of Munshif, Barisal, be declared illegal, void, without jurisdiction and not binding upon the plaintiff. The defendant petitioner contested the suit by filing written statement. and denying the material allegations made in the plaint and asserted that the Solenama is a genuine one and also asserted that Kabala of Sayedunnessa is collusive, fraudulent and without consideration and it was never acted upon.
